newsitem.title: USA: U.S corp bond calendar lightens after heavy supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S corp bond calendar lightens after heavy supply.

text.p: A quiet day is on tap for the corporate bond primary market as only a few names remain on the calendar after this week's bulk of new supply, players said.
"We're working off an old calendar," said one player. "There are no new names but we do have a few that have been out there."
One such deal is Bayerische Landesbank's $1.0 billion 10-year debt offering which is expected to be launched and priced early next week, players said.
